description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 19.09.2016 - 25.09.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory requirements for international trade.
